title: Years ahead
tipStart: **Starts from:** {start}, the money in your bank accounts and wallets today (the same as **In your accounts** on Home). Pension money is not included.
tipAdd: **Each month adds:** {m}, the amount in **Set aside each month**.
tipGrow: **Grows:** {pc}% each year, the choice in **Growth each year**.
tipNoGrow: **Does not grow:** **Growth each year** is 0%, so the money stays the same, like money in a regular bank account.
tipGuess: This is only a guess, not a promise.
neverYears: Not within {n} year | Not within {n} years
reachTip:
**Your goal:** {goal}, the amount you want to have. Type any amount in **Your goal**.
**Set aside each month:** {m}.
reachTipAvg: **Sooner or later:** compared with setting aside your average, {amount} a month (money in minus money out in your last full months).
needNone: the money you have gets there by itself
needTipAge: What to set aside each month to have {goal} by age {age}.
needTipYears: What to set aside each month to have {goal} in {n} year. | What to set aside each month to have {goal} in {n} years.
avgFrom: What you kept in the last full month ({range}): money in minus money out. | What you kept each month in the last {n} full months ({range}): money in minus money out, averaged.
sooner: {n} year sooner than at your average | {n} years sooner than at your average
later: {n} year later than at your average | {n} years later than at your average
soonerLt: a few months sooner than at your average
laterLt: a few months later than at your average
needYears: Needed in {n} year | Needed in {n} years
needSame: about what you set aside each month now
avgNeg: In the last full month ({range}), about {amount} more went out than came in, so it counts as ₪0. | In the last {n} full months ({range}), about {amount} a month more went out than came in, so it counts as ₪0.
avgNone: There isn't a full month yet, so it counts as ₪0 for now.
avgTip:
**Not counted:** money you moved between your own accounts, card bill payments (each card purchase is already counted), payments that have not happened yet, and rows you chose to leave out.
**Number of months:** follows **Based on the last** on the Forecast page.
noAge: Add your age to see this by age. Until then, it counts in years from today.
mTip:
Set aside each month
The amount you put away every month. Type or drag to try another amount.
gTip:
Growth each year
How much the money you set aside might grow each year. It is only a guess: it can be more, less, or even go down.
**0%:** the money doesn't grow. It stays the same, like money in a regular bank account.
**3%:** money that grows slowly and safely, like a savings plan or a fixed deposit at the bank.
**5%:** money invested for many years, like a pension fund, a study fund (keren hishtalmut) or stocks.
chartLabel: Your money over the years: with the amount set aside each month, with your average, and your goal.
atTip:
By age
The age to look at. Type an age or drag the slider.
yrsTip:
In how many years
How many years from today to look at. Type a number or drag the slider.
goalTip:
Your goal
The amount you want to have. Type any amount.
saveTip:
Save this goal
Keeps your goal, the amount set aside each month, the age and the growth. Home then shows how close you are to your goal.
updateTip:
Update goal
Saves the choices as they are now in place of your saved goal.
goalNoneSub: Save it to follow your progress toward it on the Home page.
goalSavedYears: Saved: {goal} in {n} year | Saved: {goal} in {n} years
goalSavedSub: You can follow your progress toward it on the Home page.
savedDiffAge: Your saved goal is {goal} by age {age}.
savedDiffYears: Your saved goal is {goal} in {n} year. | Your saved goal is {goal} in {n} years.
rmText: Your goal will no longer show on Home. The choices in Years ahead stay as they are, and you can undo this.
